Name: Deluxe Auto-Petter
Author: Frostiverse
Description:
[b][size=6]Deluxe Auto-Petter[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Overview[/size][/b]
[size=2]This mod adds a new quest that ultimately leads to Marnie selling Deluxe Auto-Petters. The next day after you acquire your first Auto-Petter, you will receive a letter in the mail that triggers the quest.

[b]Even if you already found an Auto-Petter before installing this mod, you will need to acquire an Auto-Petter into your inventory again in order to trigger the quest.[/b]

Notes:
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]This mod has only been tested on PC. Use at your own risk on other platforms.[/size]
[*][b][size=2]This was tested in multiplayer, but NOT tested in split screen mode.[/size][/b]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[*][size=2]Unzip this mod's folder into 'Stardew Valley/Mods'[/size]

[/list][size=2]Optional Step:
[list]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿[/size]
[/list][/size]
[b][size=4]Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]Adds a new quest that gets triggered after you acquire an Auto-Petter[/size]
[size=2][b]Please note: [/b]Even if you already found/own an Auto-Petter before installing this mod, you will need to put it into your inventory again in order to trigger the quest.[/size][*][size=2]After completing the quest, Marnie will sell Deluxe Auto-Petters for 75,000g[/size]
[*][size=2]Automatically applies a manual-pet to all of your animals (+15 friendship, +30 with Coopmaster)[/size]
[*][size=2]Configurable amount of additional friendship gain. If you install Generic Mod Config Menu, then there will be an in-game menu for Deluxe Auto-Petter with a single slider option that defines the additional amount of friendship gain, up to 1000 (max friendship).[/size]
[*][size=2]Gain farming experience for the pets that the Deluxe Auto-Petter gives to farm animals.[/size]
[b]Please note: [/b]Only the owner of the animal gets the experience.[*][size=2]Works with pets![/size]
[size=2][b]Please note: [/b]Pets only gain the friendship from the Deluxe Auto-Petter if they start the day in the same location as the Deluxe Auto-Petter. For example, if you place a Deluxe Auto-Petter outside on your farm, but your pets are inside on the start of the next day due to rain, then they will not be petted by the Deluxe Auto-Petter.
[/size][/list]
[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]Toggleable 'Global Petting' configuration option. Having this option turned on allows a single Deluxe Auto-Petter, placed anywhere in the world, to pet all of your animals and pets.[/size]
[*][size=2]Marnie will now also sell the crafting recipe for the Deluxe Auto-Petter[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Special Thanks![/size][/b]
[size=2]Thank you [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/tryvou/about-me?gameId=1303]tryvou[/url] for the new Deluxe Auto-Petter texture![/size]

[b][size=4]Source Code[/size][/b]
[url=https://github.com/Hunter-Chambers/StardewValleyMods/releases/tag/DeluxeAutoPetter][size=2]Deluxe Auto-Petter - GitHub[/size][/url]
